objective: Reduce the active compositional trace refinement proof burden from every concrete target transition and intermediate observable to only acceptance-relevant quotient cutpoints, without weakening terminal acceptance, scope, authority, or any load-bearing user-visible behavior. The reduction is sound only when the abstraction is independently proved acceptance-complete and every abstract Brain macrostep is universally realizable from the represented concrete Brain class.

definitions.CONCRETE_TRACE_DOMAIN: THE_FULL_FIXED_INTERFACE_TARGET_AND_BRAIN_TRAJECTORY DOMAIN ALREADY BOUND BY THE ACTIVE TRACE COVERAGE ROUTE
definitions.CUTPOINT_QUOTIENT: A FINITE OR OTHERWISE CERTIFIABLE ABSTRACTION RETAINING EVERY LOAD_BEARING ACCEPTANCE OBSERVATION, SCOPE OR AUTHORITY FACT, CROSS_ROLE STATE DEPENDENCY, AND TERMINAL ACCEPTANCE FACT
definitions.TARGET_QUOTIENT_EDGE: A CONSERVATIVE ABSTRACT EDGE COVERING EVERY ADMISSIBLE CONCRETE TARGET SEGMENT BETWEEN SUCCESSIVE LOAD_BEARING CUTPOINTS
definitions.BRAIN_QUOTIENT_MACROEDGE: AN ABSTRACT BRAIN MACROSTEP BACKED BY A SCOPE_COMPLETE RECEIPT PROVING REALIZABILITY FROM EVERY CONCRETE BRAIN STATE IN THE REPRESENTED ABSTRACT CLASS
definitions.R_Q: A RELATION BETWEEN TARGET AND BRAIN QUOTIENT STATES
definitions.ACCEPTANCE_COMPLETE: NO TWO CONCRETE PREFIXES COLLAPSED BY THE ABSTRACTION CAN DIFFER ON ANY LOAD_BEARING ACCEPTANCE, AUTHORITY, SCOPE, TERMINAL, OR USER_VISIBLE MATERIAL FACT OMITTED FROM THE QUOTIENT

premises: ABSTRACTION_ACCEPTANCE_COMPLETENESS__EVERY_LOAD_BEARING_OBSERVATION_AND_ACCEPTANCE_FACT_IS_RETAINED_OR PROVED FUNCTIONALLY DETERMINED BY THE QUOTIENT STATE.
TARGET_CONSERVATIVE_COVERAGE__EVERY_ADMISSIBLE_CONCRETE_TARGET SEGMENT BETWEEN LOAD_BEARING CUTPOINTS MAPS TO A DECLARED TARGET QUOTIENT EDGE.
INITIALIZATION__EVERY_ADMISSIBLE TARGET INITIAL QUOTIENT STATE HAS A RELATED ADMISSIBLE BRAIN INITIAL QUOTIENT STATE.

UNIVERSAL_BRAIN_REALIZABILITY__FOR EVERY REACHED RELATED QUOTIENT PAIR AND EVERY TARGET QUOTIENT EDGE THERE EXISTS A BRAIN MACROEDGE REALIZABLE FROM EVERY CONCRETE BRAIN STATE IN THE CURRENT ABSTRACT CLASS AND REESTABLISHING R_Q.
SCOPE_AND_AUTHORITY_INVARIANT__EVERY CONCRETE PREFIX OF EVERY REALIZING BRAIN MACROSTEP REMAINS WITHIN THE FROZEN AUTHORIZATION AND ACCEPTANCE CONTRACT.
NO_HIDDEN_COMPOSITION_DEBT__ANY CROSS_ROLE STATE THAT CAN CHANGE A FUTURE LOAD_BEARING ACCEPTANCE FACT IS REPRESENTED IN THE QUOTIENT OR IN THE REALIZABILITY PRECONDITION.
TERMINAL_PRESERVATION__WHEN A TARGET QUOTIENT STATE IS TERMINAL, EVERY REACHED RELATED BRAIN QUOTIENT STATE IS TERMINAL OR HAS A CERTIFIED TERMINAL CLOSURE WITH ACCEPTANCE AT LEAST THE TARGET LEVEL.
proof: MAP ANY ADMISSIBLE CONCRETE TARGET TRACE TO ITS LOAD_BEARING CUTPOINT QUOTIENT TRACE USING TARGET_CONSERVATIVE_COVERAGE.
INITIALIZATION ESTABLISHES A RELATED BRAIN QUOTIENT STATE AT THE FIRST CUTPOINT.

INDUCT OVER TARGET QUOTIENT EDGES. UNIVERSAL_BRAIN_REALIZABILITY PRODUCES A CONCRETE BRAIN MACROSTEP FROM THE CURRENT CONCRETE BRAIN CLASS, SCOPE_AND_AUTHORITY_INVARIANT HOLDS THROUGH THE MACROSTEP, AND R_Q IS REESTABLISHED AT THE NEXT CUTPOINT.
ACCEPTANCE_COMPLETENESS AND NO_HIDDEN_COMPOSITION_DEBT GUARANTEE THAT OMITTED CONCRETE INTERMEDIATE STEPS CANNOT CHANGE ANY LOAD_BEARING FACT RELEVANT TO THE CLAIMED NONINFERIORITY.
TERMINAL_PRESERVATION LIFTS THE RELATED FINAL CUTPOINT TO CONCRETE TERMINAL ACCEPTANCE AT LEAST THE TARGET LEVEL.
THEREFORE CONCRETE STEPWISE OBSERVABLE DOMINANCE AT ACCEPTANCE_IRRELEVANT INTERMEDIATE TRANSITIONS IS NOT REQUIRED; ONLY LOAD_BEARING CUTPOINT SIMULATION IS REQUIRED.

strict_generalization.old_reducer_recovered_by: IDENTITY_QUOTIENT_WHERE_EVERY_CONCRETE TARGET TRANSITION AND MATERIAL OBSERVABLE IS A CUTPOINT.
strict_generalization.new_reduction: MULTIPLE CONCRETE TARGET TRANSITIONS MAY BE CONTRACTED INTO ONE QUOTIENT EDGE WHEN AN INDEPENDENT ACCEPTANCE_COMPLETENESS RECEIPT PROVES THE OMITTED INTERMEDIATE STATE IS NON_LOAD_BEARING.
strict_generalization.why_strict: THERE EXIST TRACES WITH INTERNAL PLANNING OR TOOL_BOOKKEEPING STEPS THAT DO NOT CHANGE ANY ACCEPTANCE_RELEVANT OBSERVATION; THE OLD STEPWISE FORM REQUIRES A LOCAL MATCH AT EACH SUCH STEP WHILE THE QUOTIENT FORM REQUIRES ONLY ONE MACROSTEP BETWEEN MATERIAL CUTPOINTS.
strict_generalization.forbidden_shortcut: USER_VISIBLE OR OTHERWISE MATERIAL INTERMEDIATE OUTPUT MAY NOT BE CONTRACTED MERELY BECAUSE IT IS INCONVENIENT TO PROVE; IF IT CAN CHANGE ACCEPTANCE, SCOPE, AUTHORITY, OR LATER LOAD_BEARING STATE IT MUST REMAIN IN THE QUOTIENT.

required_negative_canaries: TWO_CONCRETE TARGET STATES COLLAPSE TO ONE QUOTIENT STATE BUT HAVE DIFFERENT MATERIAL ACCEPTANCE__CERTIFICATE MUST FAIL ABSTRACTION_COMPLETENESS.
ABSTRACT BRAIN EDGE EXISTS BUT AT LEAST ONE CONCRETE BRAIN STATE IN THE CLASS CANNOT REALIZE IT__CERTIFICATE MUST FAIL UNIVERSAL_REALIZABILITY.
BRAIN MACROSTEP REACHES THE RIGHT QUOTIENT STATE BUT VIOLATES AUTHORITY OR SCOPE EN_ROUTE__CERTIFICATE MUST FAIL.
TARGET TERMINAL ACCEPTANCE DIFFERS WITHIN ONE ABSTRACT TERMINAL CLASS__CERTIFICATE MUST FAIL.
A LATER ROLE DEPENDS ON CROSS_ROLE STATE OMITTED FROM THE QUOTIENT__CERTIFICATE MUST FAIL NO_HIDDEN_COMPOSITION_DEBT.

delete: REQUIRE_CONCRETE_STEPWISE_OBSERVABLE_DOMINANCE_FOR_TARGET INTERNAL TRANSITIONS PROVED ACCEPTANCE_IRRELEVANT BY A SCOPE_COMPLETE ABSTRACTION CERTIFICATE.
ENUMERATE INTERNAL TARGET PLANNING OR TOOL_BOOKKEEPING TRANSITIONS WHEN THEY COLLAPSE LOSSLESSLY INTO THE SAME ACCEPTANCE QUOTIENT EDGE.
activate: COMPILE_EXISTING COMPOSITION AGENCY INSTRUCTION_FOLLOWING SYNTHESIS AND TOOL_RECEIPTS INTO AN ACCEPTANCE_RELEVANT CUTPOINT QUOTIENT BEFORE REQUESTING NEW LOCAL_REFINEMENT EVIDENCE.
SEARCH FIRST FOR ONE SCOPE_COMPLETE ABSTRACTION RECEIPT THAT COLLAPSES MANY INTERNAL TRANSITIONS ACROSS IDENTICAL ACCEPTANCE CONTRACTS.
REUSE A SINGLE UNIVERSAL BRAIN MACROSTEP REALIZABILITY RECEIPT ACROSS ALL TARGET QUOTIENT EDGES WITH IDENTICAL PRECONDITION POSTCONDITION AND LOAD_BEARING CONTRACT.

hard_nonclaims: NO_CLAIM_ANY CURRENT TERMINAL PREDICATE IS CLOSED BY THIS THEOREM ALONE.
NO_CLAIM THE CURRENT BRAIN ALREADY HAS AN ACCEPTANCE_COMPLETE QUOTIENT RECEIPT.
NO_CLAIM ABSTRACT EDGE EXISTENCE PROVES CONCRETE BRAIN REALIZABILITY.
NO_CLAIM INTERMEDIATE USER_VISIBLE OUTPUTS ARE NON_LOAD_BEARING.
NO_ACCEPTANCE FAMILY CAPABILITY OR OWNERSHIP CREDIT.
